title: Programme binding (.github/toolkit-programme.json), version 2
description: The repository's own Toolkit governance setting. Only the binding merged on the default branch counts, on every computer: a working tree, another branch or a fork's copy never does. Repository identity comes from the origin remote and GitHub; this file must agree and cannot override it. Child issues come from native sub-issues, never from the binding. Version 1 bindings are still read, as enabled with one parent.

governance.description: enabled turns Toolkit's GitHub governance on for this repository; disabled keeps it off, and only an owner-merged pull request changes it.

parents.description: The programme parent issues. The first is the one the reconciler records against.

kind.description: The store backend. The only kind is github: a separate private repository written through the Contents API.

repository.description: A separate private repository; verified private and writable before every pass.

required_checks.description: Check names that count as required at the PR head, in addition to the checks GitHub marks required. With none of either, checks are never GREEN.

paid_security.description: Deprecated. Toolkit never turns on a GitHub feature that needs billing: off or on is accepted and ignored.

dependency_updates.description: How Dependabot updates are merged, as in version 1. Only the binding merged on the default branch counts.

projection.description: Where the Programme Graph goes on the parent issue page, as in version 1.
